extra.rung_note: Recorded baseline; the 24 GB tier. Must reproduce the known source-hit range before any other rung runs.

per_question.question: What is the maximum power consumption of the PanelView 800 7-inch terminal, catalog number 2711R-T7T?
per_question.expected_answer: The 2711R-T7T draws a maximum of 11 W (0.40 A @ 24V DC).

per_question.question: Which replacement battery should be used for the real-time clock in a PanelView 800 terminal (2711R-T4T/T7T/T10T)?
per_question.expected_answer: Replace it only with catalog number 2711P-Y2032 or a manufacturer's equivalent such as the Matsushita or Duracell DL2032 lithium battery.

per_question.question: At what CPU temperature does a PanelView 5310 terminal go into an over-temperature condition that triggers a delayed automatic restart?
per_question.expected_answer: An over-temperature condition of 105…110 °C (221…230 °F) causes a delayed automatic system restart (normal CPU temperature is 25…94 °C).

per_question.question: What is the heat dissipation of a 12-inch PanelView Plus 7 Standard terminal such as the 2711P-T12W21D8S?
per_question.expected_answer: The 12 in. PanelView Plus 7 Standard terminal dissipates 30 W = 102 BTU.

per_question.question: What is the minimum real-time clock battery voltage considered normal on a PanelView Plus 7 Performance terminal?
per_question.expected_answer: The battery voltage must be at least 2.75V DC; 2.75V or higher is Normal (2.0…2.74V is Low, below 2.0V is Depleted).

per_question.question: What ATEX certificate number covers the non-display VersaView 5200 thin client, catalog number 6200T-NA?
per_question.expected_answer: It is covered by ATEX certificate DEMKO 19 ATEX 2252 X (marking II 3 G, Ex ec IIC T4 Gc), issued by UL International Demko A/S. The installation instructions also list a separate UK (UKEX) certificate UL21UKEX2323X and a China CCC certificate; mentioning those alongside is fine, but giving UL21UKEX2323X as the ATEX number is wrong.

per_question.question: What ingress protection rating does a VersaView 5100 industrial monitor (e.g. 6200M-15WBN) have when it is VESA-mounted instead of panel-mounted?
per_question.expected_answer: VESA mounting reduces the monitor's IP rating from IP66 to IP20 (VESA Mount: IEC IP20; Panel Mount: NEMA 4X, IEC IP66).

per_question.question: What is the operating temperature range of an ASEM 6300P panel PC fitted with a Core i7 processor?
per_question.expected_answer: 0…45 °C (32…113 °F) with a Core i7 processor (versus 0…50 °C with Core i3); the i7 throttles above 45 °C under heavy load.

per_question.question: How much RAM and user application storage does the PanelView 5500 6.5-inch terminal 2715-T7CD have?
per_question.expected_answer: 512 MB RAM and 250 MB nonvolatile storage for projects.

per_question.question: Which has the higher maximum operating temperature: the PanelView 5500 2715-T10CD or the PanelView 800 2711R-T10T?
per_question.expected_answer: The PanelView 5500 2715-T10CD, rated 0…55 °C (32…131 °F), versus 0…50 °C (32…122 °F) for the PanelView 800 2711R-T10T.

per_question.question: How does the ingress protection rating of the PanelView 5510 stainless-steel terminal 2715P-T12WD-BSK differ from the PanelView 5510 capacitive-touch terminal 2715P-C12WD?
per_question.expected_answer: The stainless-steel terminal is rated IP69 (classified by UL) and tested for IP69K per ISO 20653, while the capacitive-touch terminal is rated IP65 according to IEC 60529.

per_question.question: How many Ethernet ports does the PanelView 5310 have compared with the PanelView 5510, and which supports Device Level Ring (DLR)?
per_question.expected_answer: The PanelView 5310 has one 10/100Base-T Ethernet port, while the PanelView 5510 has two 10/100Base-T Ethernet ports that support DLR (as well as linear and star) topologies.

per_question.question: What is the power consumption of the SIMATIC KTP1200 Basic DP (Basic Panels 2nd Generation)?
per_question.expected_answer: The KTP1200 Basic DP has a power consumption of 13.2 W (the KTP1200 Basic PN variant is 12.2 W).

per_question.question: How much power does the MTP1900 Unified Comfort panel draw at 24 V DC without loads?
per_question.expected_answer: The MTP1900 Unified Comfort has a power consumption without loads of 28.8 W (rated current 1.2 A at 24 V DC without loads).

per_question.question: What is the display resolution of the SIMATIC TP2200 Comfort panel?
per_question.expected_answer: The TP2200 Comfort has a 21.5'' display with a resolution of 1920 x 1080 pixels.

per_question.question: What is the power consumption of the SIMATIC IFP2400 V2 (24") industrial flat panel?
per_question.expected_answer: The 24" IFP V2 device has a power consumption of 36 W (rated voltage 24 V DC, permitted range +19.2 V ... +28.8 V).

per_question.question: In WinCC Unified Runtime, is the script debugger enabled by default, and what are the default port numbers for the screen debugger and the job (scheduler) debugger?
per_question.expected_answer: The debugger is disabled by default; the default port is 9222 for the screen debugger and 9224 for the job debugger (both TCP).

per_question.question: How many tags can the WinCC Unified Runtime tag simulator simulate at the same time?
per_question.expected_answer: A maximum of 300 tags can be simulated at the same time, although more tags can be configured and saved in the simulator.

per_question.question: What ambient temperature range is permitted during operation for a Beckhoff CP3716 panel PC (CP37xx series)?
per_question.expected_answer: Operation: 0 °C to +45 °C (transport/storage: -20 °C ... +65 °C).

per_question.question: Does the Beckhoff CP6700-0001-0050 panel PC have fTPM 2.0 enabled?
per_question.expected_answer: No. The CP6700-0001-0050 has fTPM 2.0 not enabled; the CP6700-0001-0060 and CP6700-0001-0070 have fTPM 2.0 enabled.

per_question.question: What are the dimensions (W x H x D) of the Advantech WebOP-2080V (WOP-2080V-N4AE) operator panel?
How does the permitted DC supply voltage of the SIMATIC IFP1500 Basic compare with that of its second-generation successor, the SIMATIC HMI IM-315A?
per_question.expected_answer: The IFP1500 Basic is rated 24 V DC with a permitted range of +20.4 V to +28.8 V, whereas the IM-315A takes nominal 12-24 V DC (min. 9 V to max. 36 V), a much wider input range.

per_question.question: Compare the front and rear degree of protection of a Siemens MTP1500 Unified Comfort panel with a Beckhoff CP6600-0001-0020 panel PC.
per_question.expected_answer: The Unified Comfort panel (e.g. MTP1500) is IP65 at the front when mounted (plus UL50 Type 4X/Type 12 front face) and IP20 at the rear; the Beckhoff CP6600-0001-0020 is rated front IP54, rear IP20.

per_question.question: When connecting a Mitsubishi GOT2000 to a KEYENCE PLC over Ethernet, what is the default port No. of the connected Ethernet module in the Connected Ethernet Controller Setting?
per_question.expected_answer: The default port No. of the connected KEYENCE Ethernet module is 8501 (set to match the PLC side port No.).

per_question.question: How many Mitsubishi GOT2000 units can be connected as DeviceNet slaves to one DeviceNet master?
per_question.expected_answer: Up to 63 GOT modules (DeviceNet slave equipment) can be connected to one DeviceNet master equipment.

per_question.question: What is the maximum power consumption of the Mitsubishi GOT Simple GS2107-WTBD?
per_question.expected_answer: The GS2107-WTBD consumes 6.5 W (271 mA/24 V) or less (3.8 W (158 mA/24 V) or less with the backlight off).

per_question.question: What is the built-in clock precision of the Mitsubishi GT2107-W (GT21 wide model)?
per_question.expected_answer: The GT2107-W built-in clock precision is ±45 seconds/month at an ambient temperature of 25 °C.

per_question.question: What does the Omron NB10W-TW01B (non-V1) HMI weigh?
per_question.expected_answer: The NB10W-TW01B weighs 1525 g (power consumption 14 W).

per_question.question: Which communication protocol does an Omron NA-series HMI use to connect to an OMRON Programmable Multi-Axis Controller (Power PMAC), and what must be entered on the controller side to enable it?
per_question.expected_answer: The NA connects via Modbus/TCP (Communication Driver "Modbus/TCP", Device Series "CK3"), and the command Sys.ModbusServerEnable=1 must be entered from the PowerPMAC IDE terminal.

per_question.question: What is the ambient operating temperature range of the Omron NSH5 hand-held PT (NSH5-V2)?
per_question.expected_answer: The NSH5-V2 hand-held PT is rated for an ambient operating temperature of 0 to 40°C (power consumption 10 W max.).

per_question.question: In Delta DOPSoft, how many actions can be configured on a single Multiple actions button?
per_question.expected_answer: Up to 32 actions can be set for each of press, release and long press, so one Multiple actions button can execute up to 32*3 (96) actions.

per_question.question: What is the display resolution of the Delta DOP-110WS 10.1" HMI?
per_question.expected_answer: The DOP-110WS has a resolution of 1024 x 600 pixels.

per_question.question: How does the user memory storage (ROM) capacity of the Mitsubishi GT2712-S compare with that of the GT2512-S?
per_question.expected_answer: The GT2712-S (GT27) has 57 MB of storage ROM, whereas the GT2512-S (GT25) has 32 MB, so the GT27 has 25 MB more.

per_question.question: Which draws more power: the Omron NA5-7W or the Delta DOP-107WV 7" HMI, and what are their maximum power consumption figures?
per_question.expected_answer: The Omron NA5-7W draws more: 19 W max., versus Max. 8.4 W for the Delta DOP-107WV.

per_question.question: What input voltage range does the Weintek MT8071iP accept?
per_question.expected_answer: The MT8071iP accepts a wide input voltage range of 10.5~28VDC (power consumption 1A@12VDC; 500mA@24VDC).

per_question.question: What is the approximate weight of the Weintek cMT2158X 15-inch HMI?
per_question.expected_answer: The cMT2158X weighs approx. 2.74 kg.

per_question.question: What is the operating temperature range of the Weintek cMT-SVR-200 server?
per_question.expected_answer: The cMT-SVR-200 (and cMT-SVR-202) operates from -10° ~ 55°C (14° ~ 131°F).

per_question.question: What is the input power requirement of the Red Lion Graphite G310C, including maximum wattage?
per_question.expected_answer: The G310C requires +24 VDC ±20% at 33 W maximum (a 24 VDC supply rated at 33 W).

per_question.question: How much does the Red Lion Graphite G315C weigh?
per_question.expected_answer: The G315C weighs 11.41 lbs (5.17 Kg).

per_question.question: What is the maximum power consumption of the Schneider Harmony ST6 HMIST6700?
per_question.expected_answer: The HMIST6700 has a maximum power consumption of 18.5 W (rated input 24 Vdc).

per_question.question: What panel cutout is required to mount a Pro-face STM-6400WA display module?
per_question.expected_answer: The STM-6200WA/STM-6400WA display modules mount in a round hole of diameter 22.5 mm (0.88 in), toleranced 22.5 mm (+0/-0.3 mm).

per_question.question: What is the power consumption of the Beijer X2 pro 15 B2 at rated voltage?
per_question.expected_answer: The X2 pro 15 B2 consumes 31.2 W at rated voltage (+24 VDC).

per_question.question: What is the display resolution of the Weintek cMT3072XH?
per_question.expected_answer: The cMT3072XH has a 7" IPS display with 1024 x 600 resolution (unlike the cMT3072X, which is 800 x 480).

per_question.question: Compare the operating temperature ranges of the Weintek eMT3070A and eMT3150A.
per_question.expected_answer: The eMT3070A operates from -20° ~ 50°C (-4° ~ 122°F), while the eMT3150A operates from 0° ~ 50°C (32° ~ 122°F), so the eMT3070A tolerates colder environments.

per_question.question: How do the Red Lion FlexEdge DA50A and DA70A compare in weight?
per_question.expected_answer: The DA50A weighs 13 oz (404.3 g), while the DA70A weighs 2 lb 2.5 oz (978.05 g).

per_question.question: Which has the wider operating temperature range: the Schneider Harmony ST6 HMIST6500 or the Beijer X2 pro 10 B2?
per_question.expected_answer: The Beijer X2 pro 10 B2 is wider at -10°C to +60°C; the Harmony ST6 HMIST6500 is rated 0...50 °C (32...122 °F) ambient air temperature.

per_question.question: What is the MTBF of the Weintek cMT3072X?
per_question.expected_answer: The documents do not state an MTBF for the Weintek cMT3072X. The answer should say so and must not borrow an MTBF from another vendor's product.

per_question.question: What is the list price of the Allen-Bradley PanelView 5510?
per_question.expected_answer: The documents contain no pricing for the PanelView 5510. The answer should say pricing isn't in the library.

per_question.question: Which Bluetooth version does the Weintek cMT3162X support?
per_question.expected_answer: The documents do not mention Bluetooth for the cMT3162X (or any product). The answer should say this isn't stated rather than invent a version.

per_question.question: What is the operating temperature range of the Weintek cMT3252X?
per_question.expected_answer: There is no cMT3252X in the library, so its operating temperature cannot be answered. The answer should say so and must not substitute a similar model's range.

per_question.question: What is the display resolution of the Phoenix Contact BTP 2070W HMI?
per_question.expected_answer: The library has no Phoenix Contact HMI documentation (Phoenix Contact appears only as a connectable PLC in connection manuals), so this cannot be answered from the documents.

per_question.question: Which Linux kernel version does the Red Lion Graphite G310 run?
per_question.expected_answer: The Red Lion documents do not mention Linux or a kernel version for the Graphite G310. The answer should say this isn't stated.

per_question.question: Which HMI vendors are covered in the document library?
per_question.expected_answer: 12 vendors: Advantech, Allen-Bradley (Rockwell, incl. ASEM), Beckhoff, Beijer, Delta, Mitsubishi, Omron, Pro-face, Red Lion, Schneider, Siemens and Weintek.

per_question.question: How many Weintek documents are in the library?
per_question.expected_answer: 18 Weintek documents (datasheets, installation guide and brochures across the cMT, cMT-X, eMT, iE, iP, cMT-SVR and gateway series).

per_question.question: Which documents cover the Mitsubishi GOT2000 series?
per_question.expected_answer: 10 documents: got2000_connection_manual_microcomputer_modbus.pdf; got2000_connection_manual_non_mitsubishi_products_1.pdf; got2000_connection_manual_non_mitsubishi_products_2.pdf; got2000_graphic_operation_catalog.pdf; got2000_gt27_gt25_hardware_user_manual.pdf; got2000_gt27_gt25_utility_user_manual.pdf; got2000_series_catalog.pdf; gt21_wide_general_description.pdf; gt25_wide_general_description.pdf; gt27_general_description.pdf.

per_question.question: Which replacement battery does it take for the real-time clock?
per_question.expected_answer: Use catalog number 2711P-Y2032 (or a manufacturer's equivalent such as the Matsushita or Duracell DL2032 lithium battery).

per_question.question: What IP rating does its stainless-steel version have?
per_question.expected_answer: The PanelView 5510 stainless-steel terminal (2715P-T12WD-BSK) is rated IP69 as classified by UL and tested for IP69K according to ISO 20653.

per_question.question: How does that compare with Delta's 7-inch DOP-107WV?
per_question.expected_answer: The Delta DOP-107WV draws Max. 8.4 W, so it uses less than half the NA5-7W's 19 W max.

per_question.question: And the DA70A?
per_question.expected_answer: The FlexEdge DA70A weighs 2 lb 2.5 oz (978.05 g).

per_question.question: What about the cMT3072X?
per_question.expected_answer: The Weintek cMT3072X has an 800 x 480 display (7" TFT).

per_question.question: What is the operating temperature range of a 19-inch Allen-Bradley PanelView Plus 7 Performance terminal (2711P-T19C22D9P) if it is a Series A unit?
per_question.expected_answer: Series A 19-in. terminals are rated 0…50 °C (32…122 °F); Series B 19-in. terminals are rated 0…55 °C (32…131 °F).

per_question.question: What panel cutout dimensions are required for an Allen-Bradley ASEM 6300M 15.6-inch panel monitor (display code 15L, AF/GL/SR bezel)?
per_question.expected_answer: Dimension A 389.8 mm (15.31 in.) by Dimension B 239.3 mm (9.42 in.), with all dimensions ±1 mm.

per_question.question: Which adapter kit lets you install a 15-inch PanelView Plus 7 Performance touch-screen terminal into the panel cutout of a legacy Allen-Bradley PanelView 1400 or 1400e touch-screen terminal?
per_question.expected_answer: Adapter kit 2711P-RAAT15 (the keypad version of the 1400/1400e is replaced via 2711P-RAAK15 with a 15 in. keypad-with-touch terminal). These kits are for Plus 7 Performance terminals only, not Plus 7 Standard.

per_question.question: What is the display luminance (brightness) of the Advantech WebOP-3000T series operator panel WOP-3100T?
per_question.expected_answer: The WOP-3100T (10.1" WSVGA) has a luminance of 550 cd/m2 (the sibling WOP-3070T and WOP-3120T are 500 cd/m2).

per_question.question: What is the power consumption without loads of the Siemens SIMATIC HMI IM-319A industrial monitor?
per_question.expected_answer: The IM-319A draws 21 W without loads (24 W load-dependent); note the larger IM-322A is lower at 18 W without loads.

per_question.question: What is the maximum permitted ambient temperature for a Siemens SIMATIC TP2200 Comfort panel mounted vertically in landscape format?
per_question.expected_answer: 0 ... 45 °C for the TP1900 Comfort and TP2200 Comfort (a footnote to the 0 ... 50 °C value that applies to all other Comfort Panels).

per_question.question: What is the maximum apparent power and the maximum-load power consumption of the AC-powered Mitsubishi GT27 model GT2715-XTBA-040?
per_question.expected_answer: The GT2715-XTBA-040 (100 to 240 V AC) has a maximum apparent power of 122 VA and consumes 44 W or less under the maximum load (25 W stand-alone, 10 W with backlight off).

per_question.question: When a Delta DOP-100 HMI is connected to a Delta CNC controller using the ASCII protocol, what are the HMI factory-default control area/status area addresses and the default serial settings?
per_question.expected_answer: The factory default control area/status area is DT0/DT10, with baud rate 9600, 7 data bits, even parity, 1 stop bit and controller station number 1 (RS-485 connection).

per_question.question: When a Mitsubishi GOT connects to Siemens SIMATIC S7-300/400/1200/1500 PLCs over Ethernet using OP communication, how many PLCs can one GT21 or GS21 connect to, compared with a GT27/GT25?
per_question.expected_answer: For an N:1 (PLC:GOT) OP-communication configuration, a GT21 or GS21 can connect to 4 PLCs or less, whereas GT27, GT25, GT23 and GS25 can connect to 128 or less.

per_question.question: What is the rated power consumption of the Weintek cMT2078X 7-inch HMI?
per_question.expected_answer: The cMT2078X consumes 820mA at 24VDC (input power 24±20% VDC).

per_question.question: At what maximum ambient temperature can a Red Lion CR3000 15-inch HMI operate when the cellular modem module is fitted?
per_question.expected_answer: With the Cellular Modem Module (CRM000CMCMOD0000) or equivalent fitted, the CR3000 15" is limited to -10 to 45 °C, instead of the normal -10 to 50 °C operating range.

per_question.question: How much does the Schneider Harmony GTO HMIGTO5315 stainless-steel 10.4-inch panel weigh?
per_question.expected_answer: The HMIGTO5315 weighs 2.500 kg (the standard HMIGTO5310 weighs 2.000 kg).

per_question.question: Which draws more power at maximum: the Allen-Bradley PanelView 5510 stainless-steel 15-inch terminal 2715P-T15CD-BSK or the PanelView Plus 7 Performance stainless-steel 15-inch terminal 2711P-T15C22D9P-BSHK (Series C)?
per_question.expected_answer: The PanelView Plus 7 Performance 2711P-T15C22D9P-BSHK Series C is rated 39 W max, higher than the PanelView 5510 2715P-T15CD-BSK at 33 W.

per_question.question: Which is heavier: the Allen-Bradley PanelView Plus 7 Standard 12-inch touch terminal 2711P-T12W21D8S or the PanelView Plus 7 Performance 12.1-inch touch terminal 2711P-T12W22D9P?
per_question.expected_answer: The Plus 7 Performance 2711P-T12W22D9P weighs approx. 2.54 kg (5.60 lb), more than the Plus 7 Standard 2711P-T12W21D8S at approx. 1.95 kg (4.29 lb).

per_question.question: Which draws more power: the Advantech WOP-3070T 7-inch operator panel or the Siemens SIMATIC KTP700 Basic (2nd generation)?
per_question.expected_answer: The Advantech WOP-3070T draws more: 7 W versus 5.5 W for the Siemens KTP700 Basic (both 24 V DC).

per_question.question: How does the front degree of protection of the Siemens TP700 Comfort Outdoor compare with that of the standard TP700 Comfort panel?
per_question.expected_answer: The TP700 Comfort Outdoor front is rated IP66 (Type 4X/Type 12 indoor/outdoor) when mounted, one step higher than the standard TP700 Comfort front, which is IP65 according to IEC 60529 (Type 4X/Type 12 indoor use only). Both have IP20 at the rear.

per_question.question: Which draws more power at maximum: the Omron NA5-12W (V2) HMI or the Mitsubishi GOT2000 GT2512-WXTBD, and what are the figures?
per_question.expected_answer: The Omron NA5-12W-V2 draws more: 28 W max., versus 20 W or less under the maximum load for the Mitsubishi GT2512-WXTBD.

per_question.question: Did the maximum power consumption of the Omron NA5-12W change between the V1 and V2 hardware versions? Give both values.
per_question.expected_answer: Yes: the NA5-12W-V1 is rated 25 W max., while the NA5-12W-V2 is rated 28 W max., so the V2 draws 3 W more (the 15W, 9W and 7W models are unchanged at 29, 23 and 19 W).

per_question.question: Which 15-inch HMI is heavier: the Red Lion Graphite G15 or the Weintek cMT3152X?
per_question.expected_answer: The Red Lion Graphite G15 is heavier at 7.73 lb (3.50 kg), versus approx. 2.85 kg for the Weintek cMT3152X.

per_question.question: What front-panel ingress protection do the Weintek eMT3105P and eMT3070A have, and which is rated higher?
per_question.expected_answer: The eMT3070A has a NEMA4 / IP66 compliant front panel, while the eMT3105P is only NEMA4 / IP65 compliant, so the eMT3070A is rated higher.

per_question.question: What is the power consumption of the Siemens SIMATIC KTP1500 Basic panel?
per_question.expected_answer: There is no KTP1500 Basic in the documents; the Basic Panels 2nd Generation range is KTP400/700/900/1200. The answer should say the model is not found and must not return the KTP1200 Basic figure as if it were the KTP1500's.

per_question.question: What SIL (Safety Integrity Level) is the Beijer X2 pro 10 B2 certified to?
per_question.expected_answer: The Beijer documents do not state any SIL rating for the X2 pro 10 B2. The answer should say so and must not borrow a SIL figure from another vendor's document.

per_question.question: Does the Schneider Harmony ST6 HMIST6700 support Power over Ethernet (PoE)?
per_question.expected_answer: The documents do not mention Power over Ethernet for any Harmony ST6 model (or any HMI in the library). The answer should say the documents do not state PoE support rather than asserting yes or no.

per_question.question: Does the Beckhoff CP6600 panel PC have built-in Wi-Fi?
per_question.expected_answer: The Beckhoff documents do not mention Wi-Fi, WLAN or any wireless interface for the CP6600 (or any Beckhoff panel in the library). The answer should say this is not stated, not infer an answer from the wired-interface list.

per_question.question: Which of these Allen-Bradley small-format (6.5 to 7 in.) terminals has the highest display resolution: the PanelView 800 2711R-T7T, the PanelView Plus 7 Standard 2711P-T7C21D8S, or the PanelView 5510 2715P-T7CD?
per_question.expected_answer: The PanelView 800 2711R-T7T at 800 x 480 (WVGA). Both the Plus 7 Standard 2711P-T7C21D8S (6.5 in.) and the PanelView 5510 2715P-T7CD (6.5 in.) are 640 x 480 VGA.

per_question.question: What is the primary PanelView Plus 7 replacement for a legacy Allen-Bradley PanelView Standard 550 terminal 2711-K5A1, and how much does that replacement terminal weigh?
per_question.expected_answer: The primary replacement is the PanelView Plus 7 Standard 6-in. touch terminal 2711P-T6C21D8S (cutout 123 x 156 mm, 640 x 480, one Ethernet port); it weighs approximately 0.70 kg (1.53 lb).

per_question.question: Which of the Beckhoff CP37xx panel PC, CP6700 panel PC and CP39xx-0000 multi-touch control panel may be operated at an ambient temperature of 55 °C?
per_question.expected_answer: Only the CP39xx-0000 control panel (operation 0 °C ... +55 °C). The CP37xx is limited to 0 °C to +45 °C and the CP6700 to 0 °C ... +50 °C.

per_question.question: Which of these HMI fronts are rated IP66 rather than IP65: Advantech WOP-3070T, Siemens TP700 Comfort Outdoor, Siemens TP700 Comfort (standard), Beckhoff CP3907?
per_question.expected_answer: The Advantech WOP-3070T (IP66-rated front panel) and the Siemens TP700 Comfort Outdoor (front IP66 when mounted) are IP66; the standard Siemens TP700 Comfort front is IP65 according to IEC 60529 and the Beckhoff CP3907 (CP39xx) is IP65.

per_question.question: Of the three Mitsubishi 7-inch wide panels GT2107-WTBD, GS2107-WTBD and GT2507-WTBD, which consume more than 10 W under the maximum load? Give each value.
per_question.expected_answer: GT2107-WTBD (11.3 W or less) and GT2507-WTBD (16 W or less) exceed 10 W; the GS2107-WTBD does not, at 6.5 W (271 mA/24 V) or less.

per_question.question: In Delta DOPSoft, what is the default password offered when creating an Auto Update Data File with protection enabled, and if both a USB disk and an SD card contain an HMI_AutoUP folder, which one does the DOP-100 HMI update from first?
per_question.expected_answer: The default copy-protection password is 12345678, and the HMI updates from the USB Disk first and then from the SD Card.

per_question.question: Which of the Weintek 15-inch cMT models cMT2158X, cMT3152X and cMT3162X have an SD card slot?
per_question.expected_answer: The cMT2158X and cMT3152X both have an SD card slot supporting SD/SDHC cards; the cMT3162X has no SD card slot (N/A).

per_question.question: Which Schneider Harmony GTO panel models cannot be expanded with an SD card?
per_question.expected_answer: The HMIGTO1300, HMIGTO1310 and HMIGTO2300 have no SD card interface; all other GTO models (HMIGTO2310, 3510, 4310, 5310, 6310 and the 2315/5315/6315 stainless versions) accept the 4 GB SD card HMIZSD4G.

per_question.question: How do you replace the real-time clock battery in an Allen-Bradley PanelView Plus 7 Standard terminal (e.g. 2711P-T10C21D8S)?
per_question.expected_answer: 1) Disconnect power from the terminal. 2) Remove the battery cover by rotating it from C (closed) to O (open). 3) Press the vertical center tab on the metal latch away from the battery to release it. 4) Insert the new battery (2711P-RY2032 / CR2032) at an angle under the metal latch with the + side up. 5) Gently press down on the opposite side until it locks into place. 6) Replace the cover and rotate it from O (open) to C (closed).

per_question.question: What are the steps to mount an Allen-Bradley PanelView 5510 stainless-steel terminal (e.g. 2715P-T12WD-BSK) in a panel, and what torque is applied to the mounting clips?
per_question.expected_answer: 1) Cut the panel opening using the shipped cutout template (or the user-manual dimensions). 2) Place the terminal screen-down on a clean, flat surface. 3) Position the gasket on the bezel with the alignment plugs facing the bezel alignment features and 4) press each plug into place (compression seal, no sealing compounds). 5) Place the terminal in the cutout. 6) Position the backing plate over the terminal. 7) Slide the mounting clips into the slots. 8) Hand-tighten the clip screws until the backing plate contacts the panel uniformly. 9) Torque the clip screws to 2.3…2.6 N•m (20…23 lb•in) in the specified sequence, 10) repeating until all clips are at torque.

per_question.question: How is the mounting arm tube fitted to the mounting arm adapter of a Beckhoff CP39xx control panel, and what torques are specified?
per_question.expected_answer: 1. Unscrew the hexagon socket screw a few turns with a 3 mm Allen key. 2. Push the panel's connecting cables through the mounting arm tube. 3. Insert the tube 50.2 mm into the adapter up to the stop. 4. Retighten the hexagon socket screw to 3 Nm. 5. Tighten the adapter's slotted nut clockwise with a size 58-62 hook wrench (C9900-Z263) to 20 Nm. (Adapters fit Rittal/Rolec 48 mm tubes.)

per_question.question: Using the SIMATIC IPC Panel Drivers and Tools (PDT) UPDD Console, how do you perform the extended 25-point touch calibration on a SIMATIC IFP V2 with resistive single-touch screen?
per_question.expected_answer: 1. Open the "UPDD Console" dialog. 2. Select the touch controller of the device in the dialog header. 3. Click the "Calibration" tab. 4. Deactivate "Use eeprom storage". 5. Enter "25" under "Number of points". 6. Click "Calibrate" (calibration screen appears on the selected display). 7. Touch the selections one after the other (each confirmed with a check mark). 8. Confirm all prompts until the whole screen is calibrated. 9. Press "Confirm" at the final prompt. Unlike the 3-point calibration, the data is stored in the OS on the PC, not in the device EEPROM.

per_question.question: What is the procedure for installing the BootOS or system application on a Mitsubishi GOT2000 (GT27/GT25) from an SD card using the utility?
per_question.expected_answer: 1. Insert the SD card holding the BootOS/system application/project data into the GOT's SD card interface. 2. Close the SD card interface cover. 3. Open the data control function screen in the utility and install the BootOS/system application from the SD card. 4. The SD card access LED stays lit during installation - do not remove the card or open the cover. 5. The GOT restarts automatically when installation completes. 6. After a normal restart, confirm the access LED is off and remove the SD card.

per_question.question: How do I enter Calibrate Mode and calibrate the touch panel on an Omron NB-series HMI using the rear DIP switches?
per_question.expected_answer: 1. Set rear DIP switches SW1 to OFF and SW2 to ON. 2. Press the Reset switch to restart the NB unit into Calibrate Mode. 3. Touch each '+' shown on the screen (a touch sound confirms each) until the '+' disappears and 'TP Adjust Success!' is displayed. 4. Set both SW1 and SW2 to OFF. 5. Press the Reset switch again. (Alternatively, a Function Key component set to 'Touch Calibration' starts calibration from a project screen.)

per_question.question: How is a Pro-face SP5000 box module (e.g. SP-5B40) attached to the display module or DC power supply adapter?
per_question.expected_answer: 1) Pull the LOCK on the top of the Box Module forward to release the lock. 2) Insert the protruding points on the bottom left and right of the Box Module into the two holes on the back of the Display Module (or DC Power Supply Adapter for Box Module) to attach it. 3) Fully push the LOCK on the top of the Box Module to secure it to the Display Module or adapter.

per_question.question: What is the installation process for mounting a Beijer X2 pro 4 B2 HMI panel in a cabinet door?
per_question.expected_answer: 1) Unpack and check the delivery; notify the supplier of any damage. 2) Cut the opening using the cut-out dimensions in the outline drawing (130 x 89 mm). 3) Make sure the mounting surface of the cutout is smooth and free of burrs/debris. 4) Install the HMI panel into the cutout. 5) Secure it using all fastening holes and the provided brackets and screws, tightened to 0.5 - 1.0 Nm. 6) Where the front seal (IP54+/NEMA-4X) is critical, use a torque wrench to confirm the screw torque. 7) Connect the cables in the specified order (A, then B power using 14-20 AWG at 180-220 N-cm, then C Ethernet, then D). 8) Carefully remove the protective film from the display, avoiding static.
